verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (native v1 at /api/v1/*, OpenAI-like and Anthropic-compatible endpoints), an API changelog, llms.txt and markdown docs. None of it mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. llms.txt and .md docs are machine-readable documentation, an adjacent feature rather than an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
